+"""Regression tests for format_user after merging normalization and greeting."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from formatter import format_user
+
+
+class FormatUserTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_greeting_is_preserved(self):
+        self.assertEqual(format_user("Bob"), "Hello, Bob!")
+
+    def test_whitespace_is_normalized_before_greeting(self):
+        self.assertEqual(format_user(" Ada "), "Hello, Ada!")
+
+    def test_both_intents_combine(self):
+        self.assertEqual(format_user("  Grace  "), "Hello, Grace!")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
